confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of northern Vietnam hill-town tourist pricing, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation anchors are less certain and vary a lot by season, room type and taxes; the reference month of July is rainy-season shoulder, not peak. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local price relationship to beer, since direct knowledge is weaker. The FX rate comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the page or the F11 table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: northern Vietnam hill-station and trekking towns with tourist-facing pricing (for example Da Lat and other Vietnamese highland resort towns), adjusted upward for Sa Pa's tourist premium on accommodation and restaurant prices.
